record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, introduce a fixed training-frequency input cue: for each visible real item, scale its existing input vector by 1 + 0.05*tanh((mean_log_count - log1p(count))/std_log_count), with statistics computed over real-item training counts and standard deviation clamped above zero. Keep padding zero and mask scale one. This mildly emphasizes rarer context without the previous history-relative normalization. Preserve embedding parameterization, topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer; checkpoint the feature statistics for prediction.

category_rationales.rationale: Add a mild rarity cue from training interactions across all four datasets. Scale visible real-item input vectors by 1 + 0.05*tanh((mean_log_count - log_count)/std_log_count), keeping padding zero and mask scaling one. Checkpointed buffers preserve feature statistics in the generated predictor, which already imports the shared model class. Embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.
